name: pnpm
description: pnpm package manager — builds and installs scenario UI dependencies. Scenario lifecycle steps invoke `corepack pnpm … || pnpm …`; this tool guarantees the plain `pnpm` fallback exists on hosts where the system Node.js does not ship corepack shims (e.g. Homebrew node on macOS).

budget.rationale: Measured at 1663257387 bytes on 2026-08-03; ceiling is two times observed size.

store.rationale: The active pnpm store is discovered with `pnpm store path`; this declaration names the default user store root and uses pnpm's store-dir setting for relocation.

installHint: Installed as a pinned standalone binary into ~/.vrooli/bin (no sudo). Pinned to the workspace packageManager version in pnpm-workspace.yaml — bump both together.
notes: Pinned to pnpm 10.19.0, matching the root pnpm-workspace.yaml packageManager field. Assets are the official standalone executables from the pnpm GitHub release (raw binaries, no archive). sha256 values were computed from downloaded assets; the linux/amd64 binary was executed and reports 10.19.0.
